rfqs.title: RFQ marketplace
rfqs.description: Open requests from verified buyers. Matched RFQs fit the categories you sell in; invited ones were sent to you directly.
rfqs.searchPlaceholder: Search by title, RFQ number or keyword…
rfqs.noResultsHint: Try another category or destination, or clear the filters.

empty.all: No open RFQs at the moment
empty.quoted: You have not quoted on any RFQ yet

emptyHint.matched: Publish products in more categories to be matched with more requests, or browse every open RFQ.
emptyHint.invited: Buyers invite suppliers with a complete, verified profile. Keep your catalogue and factory profile up to date.
emptyHint.all: New requests are posted every day. Check back soon.
emptyHint.quoted: Open a matched RFQ and send your first quotation.

rfqDetail.invitedBody: {buyer} selected your company for this request. Invited suppliers are reviewed first.
rfqDetail.closedTitle: This RFQ is no longer accepting quotations
rfqDetail.closedBody: The buyer has closed this request.
rfqDetail.closedAwarded: The buyer has awarded this request to a supplier.
rfqDetail.quotedTitle: Your quotation {number} is with the buyer
rfqDetail.lineItemsHint: Quote each line separately; the buyer compares offers line by line.
rfqDetail.noQuotationYet: You have not quoted on this request yet.
rfqDetail.noQuotation: You did not quote on this request.

quotations.title: Quotations
quotations.description: Every quotation you sent, with the buyer's decision and the revision history.
quotations.emptyDescription: Find a matching RFQ and send your first quotation.
quotations.emptyTabDescription: No quotation is in this state.

quotationForm.reviseDescription: Revision {n} for "{rfq}". The buyer keeps the previous version for reference.
quotationForm.pickRfqHint: Quotations are always sent in reply to a buyer's request.
quotationForm.closedBody: The buyer no longer accepts quotations for this request.
quotationForm.buyerAsked: What the buyer asked for on {date}
quotationForm.reviseHint: Update prices, lead time or terms below. Sending creates a new revision and marks the previous one as revised.
quotationForm.itemsHint: One row per RFQ line. Add extra lines for tooling, samples or freight if you need to.
quotationForm.itemNotesPlaceholder: Material, spec or lead-time note for this line (optional)
quotationForm.termsHint: Buyers compare quotations on price, lead time and terms. Be precise.
quotationForm.validityHint: The quotation expires after this many days.
quotationForm.productionNotePlaceholder: e.g. Sample approval within 7 days, then 45 days production
quotationForm.sampleHint: Tick if you can send a pre-production sample.
quotationForm.sampleRequiredHint: The buyer asked for a sample before ordering.
quotationForm.messageHint: Explain what makes your offer strong: certifications, past exports, packaging options.
quotationForm.attachmentsHint: Spec sheets, drawings, certificates — shared with the buyer once sent.

quotationDetail.title: Quotation {number}
quotationDetail.deleteDescription: The draft and its line items are discarded. Nothing was sent to the buyer.
quotationDetail.withdrawDescription: The buyer can no longer accept it. You can send a new quotation while the RFQ is open.
quotationDetail.savedSubmittedBody: {buyer} has been notified and can accept, reject or ask for a revision.
quotationDetail.savedRevisedBody: {buyer} has been notified of the new revision.
quotationDetail.savedDraft: Draft saved. Nothing has been sent to the buyer yet.
quotationDetail.draftBody: The buyer cannot see it. Continue editing and send it when it is ready.
quotationDetail.revisionRequestedTitle: The buyer asked for a revision on {date}
quotationDetail.rejectedTitle: The buyer did not select this quotation
quotationDetail.acceptedBody: The buyer accepted this quotation and placed order {order}.
quotationDetail.supersededBody: This version is kept for reference. The buyer sees the latest revision:
quotationDetail.validityExpired: This quotation was valid until {date}. Send a revision to refresh the price and validity.

orders.title: Orders
orders.description: Purchase orders placed with your company, from confirmation to delivery.
orders.emptyDescription: Orders are created when a buyer accepts one of your quotations.

next.PURCHASE_ORDER: Review the purchase order and confirm it so the buyer can pay the deposit.
next.PAYMENT: Waiting for the buyer's deposit. Start production once the payment is confirmed.
next.PRODUCTION: Goods are in production. Move to inspection or mark as shipped when ready.
next.QUALITY_INSPECTION: Inspection in progress. Mark as shipped once the goods are released.
next.SHIPPING: Keep the shipment milestones up to date so the buyer can track the cargo.
next.DELIVERY: Delivered. The buyer confirms receipt to release the held payment.
next.COMPLETED: Completed. Payments were released to you.
next.DISPUTED: A dispute is open. Reply in the dispute thread.

orderDetail.disputeOpen: A dispute is open on this order
orderDetail.paymentsHint: Buyer payments on this order. Escrowed funds are released after the buyer confirms receipt.
orderDetail.noShipmentsYet: No shipment yet — create one when the cargo is booked.
orderDetail.timelineEmpty: Nothing has happened on this order yet.
orderDetail.tradeAssuranceHint: The buyer's payment is held by a licensed partner and released to you once receipt is confirmed.
orderDetail.noInspections: No inspection booked by the buyer.
orderDetail.financingHint: Need working capital for this order? Apply for production financing against it.
orderDetail.reviewAnswered: You replied to the buyer's review

PAYMENT.title: Confirm this purchase order?
PAYMENT.description: The buyer is asked to pay the deposit. Make sure quantities, prices and lead time are right.

PRODUCTION.title: Start production
PRODUCTION.description: Tell the buyer production has started. You can add a short note about the schedule.

PRODUCTION_back.title: Return the order to production
PRODUCTION_back.description: Use this when inspection findings require rework.

QUALITY_INSPECTION.title: Ready for inspection
QUALITY_INSPECTION.description: The goods are ready for the buyer's quality inspection.

SHIPPING.title: Mark the order as shipped
SHIPPING.description: The buyer is notified and can follow the shipment milestones.

DELIVERY.title: Mark as delivered
DELIVERY.description: Confirm that the goods reached the buyer. The buyer then confirms receipt to release the payment.

orderActions.shipmentIntro: No shipment is registered yet — enter the booking details to create one.
orderActions.noteHint: Optional — added to the order timeline.
orderActions.uploadDescription: Proforma invoice, packing list, bill of lading, certificates…
orderActions.uploadHint: PDF, images or spreadsheets, up to 10 MB each.
orderActions.noteTitle: Add a note to the timeline
orderActions.noteDescription: Visible to the buyer and your team.
orderActions.notePlaceholder: e.g. Fabric arrived, cutting starts Monday.
orderActions.disputeDescription: Use this when the buyer does not pay, cancels after production or breaks the agreed terms. Our team mediates.
orderActions.cancelDescription: The buyer is notified with your reason. Held payments are handled by our team.

shipments.title: Shipments
shipments.description: Every shipment on your orders. Keep milestones up to date so buyers can track their cargo.
shipments.emptyDescription: Create a shipment from an order in production or shipping.
shipments.emptyDescriptionShippable: {count, plural, =1 {1 order is} other {# orders are}} ready for a shipment — create one from the button above.
shipments.milestonesHint: Report each milestone as it happens — the buyer sees the same tracker.
shipments.noDocuments: No shipping documents yet — share them from the order page.

shipmentActions.createDescription: Register the booking so the buyer can follow the cargo.
shipmentActions.orderHint: Orders in production, inspection or shipping.
shipmentActions.updateDescription: Tracking number, carrier and schedule. The buyer is told when the ETA or tracking changes.
shipmentActions.eventDescription: The shipment status is updated and the buyer is notified.
shipmentActions.eventLocationPlaceholder: e.g. Cat Lai, Ho Chi Minh City
shipmentActions.eventNotePlaceholder: e.g. Loaded on vessel, departed on schedule

payments.title: Payments
payments.description: Buyer payments on your orders. Funds under Trade Assurance are held by a licensed partner until the buyer confirms receipt.
payments.pendingHint: deposits and balances not yet paid
payments.emptyDescription: Payments appear once a buyer places an order with you.
payments.licenceNote: CANG never holds client money. Payments are processed and, under Trade Assurance, held by licensed payment partners.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.emptyDescription: Invoices are raised on orders once a payment schedule exists.

financing.title: Financing
financing.description: Working capital against confirmed orders. CANG never lends — we score your company and route the file to licensed partners.
financing.applyDescription: Choose the order to finance and the amount you need. We score your company and route the file in minutes.
financing.orderHint: Confirmed orders that are not delivered yet.
financing.purposePlaceholder: e.g. Raw material purchase for order ORD-…
financing.consent: I authorise CANG to share my company data with the routed partner
financing.consentHint: Order history, credit score and the information above.
financing.emptyDescription: Finance raw materials and production against a confirmed order.
financing.partners: Partners you can be routed to
financing.partnersHint: Licensed lenders and factoring companies serving Vietnamese exporters.
financing.disclaimer: CANG is not a lender. Credit decisions, funding and repayment terms are the responsibility of the licensed partner.
financing.notRoutedHint: No partner matched automatically — our team reviews the file manually.
financing.noOffers: No offer yet. The partner is reviewing your file.
financing.acceptDescription: The partner will contact you to complete the documentation. Other offers on this application are declined.
financing.withdrawDescription: The partner is informed and any open offer lapses.

disputes.title: Disputes
disputes.description: Disputes raised by buyers on your orders, and the ones you opened. Our team mediates.
disputes.emptyHint: Good news — none of your orders is in dispute.
disputes.respondTitle: The buyer is waiting for your reply
disputes.respondBody: Reply in the thread below before {date}. Unanswered disputes are escalated to our team.
disputes.respondBodyNoDate: Reply in the thread below. Unanswered disputes are escalated to our team.
disputes.threadHint: Messages are shared with {company} and our mediation team.
disputes.mediationNote: Escrowed payments on a disputed order stay on hold until the case is resolved.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.description: What buyers say about working with you. Public replies show under the review on your supplier profile.
reviews.averageHint: {count, plural, =0 {no published reviews} =1 {from 1 review} other {from # reviews}}
reviews.emptyHint: Buyers can review an order once it is completed.
reviews.pendingHint: This review is being moderated and is not public yet. You can reply once it is published.
reviews.replyPlaceholder: Thank the buyer, address any issue, keep it short.
